event_types.name: Pop Culture Event
event_types.note: Renamed from the sheet: the original title carried a registered trademark, which Sir Peter ruled out on 2026-08-03. This sheet is dated 2026-08-02 and predates that instruction.

service_categories.name: Catering & Food Services
service_categories.rationale: The single most universally-booked service across nearly every event archetype -- full-service, buffet, food trucks, specialty diets.

service_categories.name: Bakery, Desserts & Cake Design
service_categories.rationale: Split out from catering because it's booked independently even when a separate caterer is hired (wedding cakes, dessert tables).

service_categories.name: Bar, Beverage & Mixology Services
service_categories.rationale: Distinct licensing/staffing needs from food catering; essential for weddings and social events, common everywhere else.

service_categories.name: DJs, Live Bands & Musicians
service_categories.rationale: Music is the #1 most-requested entertainment booking across weddings, corporate, and social events.

service_categories.name: Entertainment, Performers & Activities
service_categories.rationale: Non-musical entertainment -- magicians, dancers, kids entertainers, interactive activities -- kept separate from DJs/Bands since booking needs differ.

service_categories.name: Photography & Videography
service_categories.rationale: Near-universal booking for milestone and wedding events; increasingly common at corporate events for content/marketing.

service_categories.name: Event Planning & Day-Of Coordination
service_categories.rationale: The connective-tissue service that spans every archetype, from full-service planning to single-day coordination.

service_categories.name: Decor, Floral & Balloon Design
service_categories.rationale: Visual styling is one of the top 3 line items on almost every event budget; balloons kept as a subtype here rather than a rival category.

service_categories.name: Event Rentals & Furnishings
service_categories.rationale: Tables, tents, lounge furniture, dance floors -- the physical infrastructure layer nearly every in-person event needs.

service_categories.name: Venues & Event Spaces
service_categories.rationale: Listing/booking the physical location itself is a distinct marketplace vertical from the services delivered inside it.

service_categories.name: Audio, Visual, Lighting & Staging
service_categories.rationale: Technical production -- sound, lighting design, staging -- especially essential for corporate and civic events.

service_categories.name: Officiants, Hosts & Ceremonial Leaders
service_categories.rationale: Weddings, memorials, and civic events all need a ceremonial or MC figure; kept distinct from entertainment performers.

service_categories.name: Hair, Makeup & Wardrobe Styling
service_categories.rationale: A well-established standalone gig category (bridal beauty teams) with its own professional certifications.

service_categories.name: Transportation & Valet Services
service_categories.rationale: Guest and wedding-party transport, valet parking -- a recurring need distinct from general event logistics.

service_categories.name: Security & Crowd Management
service_categories.rationale: Essential at festivals, civic events, and large corporate gatherings; a distinct licensed-professional category.

service_categories.name: Event Staffing & Guest Services
service_categories.rationale: The people layer -- servers, ushers, registration staff, coat check -- that supports every other category.

service_categories.name: Photo Booths & Interactive Experiences
service_categories.rationale: Now common enough at weddings, corporate, and social events to be its own booking category rather than a photography add-on.

service_categories.name: Party Rentals & Inflatables
service_categories.rationale: Family-facing rentals (bounce houses, water slides) with distinct vendors from general event rentals.

service_categories.name: Invitations, Printing & Signage
service_categories.rationale: Pre-event and on-site print/design needs -- invites, seating charts, banners, badges -- grouped since one vendor type often covers all three.

service_categories.name: Favors, Gifting & Awards
service_categories.rationale: Take-home items and recognition pieces -- guest favors, corporate gifts, trophies -- share vendors (engravers, branders).

service_categories.name: Cleaning, Sanitation & Waste Services
service_categories.rationale: Post-event cleanup and portable sanitation, a recurring practical need across outdoor and large-scale events.

service_categories.name: Event Technology & Livestreaming
service_categories.rationale: Ticketing, RFID, livestreaming, hybrid platforms -- a fast-growing modern category with no true home in a traditional taxonomy.

service_categories.name: Trade Show & Exhibit Services
service_categories.rationale: Corporate-specific booth design/build/staffing needs distinct enough from general AV and rentals to warrant its own category.

service_categories.name: Fundraising & Auction Services
service_categories.rationale: Charity/fundraiser-specific tooling (auction platforms, auctioneers, donor management) that doesn't fit elsewhere.

service_categories.name: Funeral & Memorial Services
service_categories.rationale: A distinct, sensitive service vertical (officiants, caskets, tributes) that shouldn't be folded into general planning.

service_categories.name: Pet Services for Events
service_categories.rationale: A small but real niche (pet-friendly coordination, therapy animals, mobile petting zoos) worth keeping visible as its own category.

service_categories.name: Property Staging & Real Estate Event Services
service_categories.rationale: Serves the Real Estate Event type specifically -- staging, open-house coordination, property photography.
